555: /// Conditional `PUT` that creates one supported timed, non-recurring event
556: /// through the domain service and persists the DAV resource mapping.
557: ///
558: /// Requires `If-None-Match: *`. Fails with 412 when the resource already
559: /// exists, 409 when the client-supplied UID is already mapped in the
560: /// calendar, and rolls back the event when the mapping cannot be written.
561: async fn handle_put_create_event_resource(
562:     accounts: &CaldavAccountService,
563:     session: &DavSession,
564:     principal_id: &str,
565:     calendar: &CaldavCalendar,
566:     resource_name: &str,
567:     request: Request,
568: ) -> Response {
569:     let if_none_match = request
570:         .headers()
571:         .get(header::IF_NONE_MATCH)
572:         .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok());
573:     if if_none_match != Some("*") {
574:         return (
575:             StatusCode::PRECONDITION_REQUIRED,
576:             "If-None-Match: * is required to create a resource",
577:         )
578:             .into_response();
579:     }
580: 
581:     let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(&calendar.role) else {
582:         return dav_server_error();
583:     };
584:     if authorize_calendar_action(
585:         UserStatus::Active,
586:         Some(PlatformRole::User),
587:         Some(role),
588:         CalendarAction::CreateEvent,
589:     ) != AuthorizationDecision::Allow
590:     {
591:         return dav_resource_not_found();
592:     }
593: 
594:     let body = match axum::body::to_bytes(request.into_body(), query::MAX_BODY_BYTES).await {
595:         Ok(body) => body,
596:         Err(_) => return dav_bad_request("request body too large"),
597:     };
598:     let body_str = match std::str::from_utf8(&body) {
599:         Ok(value) => value,
600:         Err(_) => return dav_bad_request("request body must be UTF-8"),
601:     };
602:     let parsed = match parse_calendar(body_str, IcsParserLimits::default()) {
603:         Ok(parsed) => parsed,
604:         Err(_) => return dav_bad_request("invalid calendar data"),
605:     };
606:     if parsed.events.is_empty() {
607:         return dav_bad_request("at least one VEVENT is required");
608:     }
609:     if let Err(message) = validate_dav_write(&parsed) {
610:         return dav_bad_request(message);
611:     }
612:     let masters: Vec<_> = parsed
613:         .events
614:         .iter()
615:         .filter(|event| event.recurrence_id.is_none())
616:         .collect();
617:     if masters.len() != 1 {
618:         return dav_bad_request("a recurring resource requires exactly one master VEVENT");
619:     }
620:     let master = masters[0];
621:     let exceptions: Vec<_> = parsed
622:         .events
623:         .iter()
624:         .filter(|e| e.recurrence_id.is_some())
625:         .collect();
626:     if exceptions.len() + 1 != parsed.events.len()
627:         || exceptions.iter().any(|event| event.uid != master.uid)
628:     {
629:         return dav_bad_request("recurring VEVENTs must share one UID");
630:     }
631:     let timing = match &master.timing {
632:         crate::ics::NormalizedTiming::Timed {
633:             starts_at,
634:             ends_at,
635:             timezone,
636:         } => EventTiming::Timed {
637:             start_utc: starts_at.timestamp(),
638:             end_utc: ends_at.timestamp(),
639:             timezone: timezone.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "UTC".to_owned()),
640:         },
641:         crate::ics::NormalizedTiming::AllDay {
642:             start_date,
643:             end_date,
644:         } => EventTiming::AllDay {
645:             start_date: start_date.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
646:             end_date: end_date.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
647:         },
648:     };
649:     if timing_end_not_after_start(&timing) {
650:         return dav_bad_request("event end must be after start");
651:     }
652:     let status = match master.status.as_deref() {
653:         Some("TENTATIVE") => EventStatus::Tentative,
654:         Some("CANCELLED") => EventStatus::Cancelled,
655:         _ => EventStatus::Confirmed,
656:     };
657:     if master.summary.trim().is_empty() {
658:         return dav_bad_request("SUMMARY is required");
659:     }
660:     let client_properties = client_properties_from(master);
661: 
662:     let repository = CaldavRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
663:     if repository
664:         .resolve_by_name(calendar.calendar_id, resource_name)
665:         .await
666:         .ok()
667:         .flatten()
668:         .is_some()
669:     {
670:         return (StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED, "resource already exists").into_response();
671:     }
672: 
673:     let mutation = EventMutation {
674:         title: master.summary.clone(),
675:         description: master.description.clone(),
676:         location: master.location.clone(),
677:         status,
678:         timing,
679:     };
680:     let event_service = EventService::new_at(accounts.pool().clone(), accounts.now());
681:     let projection = if let Some(rrule) = &master.rrule {
682:         match event_service
683:             .create_recurring(
684:                 session.user_id,
685:                 false,
686:                 calendar.calendar_id,
687:                 mutation,
688:                 rrule.clone(),
689:             )
690:             .await
691:         {
692:             Ok(projection) => projection,
693:             Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
694:         }
695:     } else {
696:         if !exceptions.is_empty() || !master.exdates.is_empty() {
697:             return dav_bad_request("EXDATE and RECURRENCE-ID require RRULE");
698:         }
699:         match event_service
700:             .create(session.user_id, false, calendar.calendar_id, mutation)
701:             .await
702:         {
703:             Ok(projection) => projection,
704:             Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
705:         }
706:     };
707:     let event_id = projection.id;
708: 
709:     if master.rrule.is_some() {
710:         let mut expected_version = projection.version.unwrap_or(1);
711:         for exdate in &master.exdates {
712:             let result = match exdate {
713:                 crate::ics::NormalizedDateValue::Timed(dt) => event_service
714:                     .delete_occurrence(
715:                         session.user_id,
716:                         false,
717:                         calendar.calendar_id,
718:                         event_id,
719:                         dt.timestamp(),
720:                         expected_version,
721:                     )
722:                     .await,
723:                 crate::ics::NormalizedDateValue::AllDay(date) => event_service
724:                     .delete_all_day_occurrence(
725:                         session.user_id,
726:                         false,
727:                         calendar.calendar_id,
728:                         event_id,
729:                         &date.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
730:                         expected_version,
731:                     )
732:                     .await,
733:             };
734:             match result {
735:                 Ok(next_projection) => {
736:                     expected_version = next_projection.version.unwrap_or(expected_version);
737:                 }
738:                 Err(_) => {
739:                     let _ = event_service
740:                         .delete(session.user_id, false, calendar.calendar_id, event_id)
741:                         .await;
742:                     return dav_server_error();
743:                 }
744:             }
745:         }
746:         for exception in &exceptions {
747:             let result = match exception.recurrence_id.as_ref().unwrap() {
748:                 crate::ics::NormalizedDateValue::Timed(dt) => {
749:                     let exc_timing = match &exception.timing {

756:                             end_utc: ends_at.timestamp(),
757:                             timezone: timezone
758:                                 .clone()
759:                                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "UTC".to_owned()),
760:                         },
761:                         crate::ics::NormalizedTiming::AllDay {
762:                             start_date,
763:                             end_date,
764:                         } => EventTiming::AllDay {
765:                             start_date: start_date.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
766:                             end_date: end_date.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
767:                         },
768:                     };
769:                     let exc_status = match exception.status.as_deref() {
770:                         Some("TENTATIVE") => EventStatus::Tentative,
771:                         Some("CANCELLED") => EventStatus::Cancelled,
772:                         _ => EventStatus::Confirmed,
773:                     };
774:                     event_service
775:                         .update_occurrence(
776:                             session.user_id,
777:                             false,
778:                             calendar.calendar_id,
779:                             event_id,
780:                             crate::event::OccurrenceChange {
781:                                 recurrence_id: dt.timestamp(),
782:                                 expected_version,
783:                                 event: EventMutation {
784:                                     title: exception.summary.clone(),
785:                                     description: exception.description.clone(),
786:                                     location: exception.location.clone(),
787:                                     status: exc_status,
788:                                     timing: exc_timing,
789:                                 },
790:                             },
791:                         )
792:                         .await
793:                 }
794:                 crate::ics::NormalizedDateValue::AllDay(date) => {
795:                     let exc_timing = match &exception.timing {
796:                         crate::ics::NormalizedTiming::Timed {
797:                             starts_at,
798:                             ends_at,
799:                             timezone,
800:                         } => EventTiming::Timed {
801:                             start_utc: starts_at.timestamp(),
802:                             end_utc: ends_at.timestamp(),
803:                             timezone: timezone
804:                                 .clone()
805:                                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "UTC".to_owned()),
806:                         },
807:                         crate::ics::NormalizedTiming::AllDay {
808:                             start_date,
809:                             end_date,
810:                         } => EventTiming::AllDay {
811:                             start_date: start_date.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
812:                             end_date: end_date.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
813:                         },
814:                     };
815:                     let exc_status = match exception.status.as_deref() {
816:                         Some("TENTATIVE") => EventStatus::Tentative,
817:                         Some("CANCELLED") => EventStatus::Cancelled,
818:                         _ => EventStatus::Confirmed,
819:                     };
820:                     event_service
821:                         .update_all_day_occurrence(
822:                             session.user_id,
823:                             false,
824:                             calendar.calendar_id,
825:                             event_id,
826:                             crate::event::AllDayOccurrenceChange {
827:                                 recurrence_date: date.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
828:                                 expected_version,
829:                                 event: EventMutation {
830:                                     title: exception.summary.clone(),
831:                                     description: exception.description.clone(),
832:                                     location: exception.location.clone(),
833:                                     status: exc_status,
834:                                     timing: exc_timing,
835:                                 },
836:                             },
837:                         )
838:                         .await
839:                 }
840:             };
841:             match result {
842:                 Ok(next_projection) => {
843:                     expected_version = next_projection.version.unwrap_or(expected_version);
844:                 }
845:                 Err(_) => {
846:                     let _ = event_service
847:                         .delete(session.user_id, false, calendar.calendar_id, event_id)
848:                         .await;
849:                     return dav_server_error();
850:                 }
851:             }
852:         }
853:     }

856:     let resource = match repository
857:         .create_resource(
858:             calendar.calendar_id,
859:             event_id,

861:             resource_name,
862:             now,

864:         .await
